source: Mope.io Wiki 'Game Modes' and the individual mode pages (CC BY-SA, facts only); dates verified, rules summarised
note: Original dates are shown in the menu; every implemented mode is playable in every version as a bonus (a version's own era is noted).

modes.name: Free For All
modes.description: The standard game: eat, grow, evolve.

modes.name: Sandbox
modes.confidence: wiki-verified dates; rules from the archived 2017 client
modes.description: Upgrade/downgrade with the arrow keys; all animals can damage each other.

modes.name: 1v1 Arena
modes.confidence: wiki: sub-mode for tier 15+ animals; rules inferred
modes.description: Duel in an enclosed arena (no healing). A bot fills in if nobody joins.

modes.name: 1v1 Redemption
modes.confidence: wiki: tier 15-16, 10 AI bosses, 1 credit per round, Noob 400 / Pro 750 coins; boss stats inferred
modes.description: Fight 10 increasingly tough AI bosses for coins. Costs one Redemption credit (buy them in the Store).

modes.name: Classic Mode
modes.confidence: wiki: replica of Dec 2016, Land + Ocean only, 14 tiers ending in Dragon; removal date approximate
modes.description: Old Mope: two biomes, 14 tiers, no later features (menus and art of the 2017 build).

modes.name: Zombie Infection
modes.confidence: wiki rules (infection bar, zombies bite anything, evolve to cure); numbers inferred; infection orbs/lotus/healing stones not simulated
modes.description: Avoid the virus. Fully infected animals become zombies.

modes.name: Battle Royale
modes.confidence: wiki rules (shrinking red zone, last alive wins, 25+ players, ghosts spectate); eggs/ghost toggle not simulated; numbers inferred
modes.description: A red zone shrinks; be the last animal alive.

modes.name: Team Mode
modes.confidence: wiki (2022 version): 3 teams, Team Stones, perks, 10-stone meteor apocalypse; only 5 of the 13 perks simulated
modes.description: Yellow, Cyan and Purple fight over Team Stones.

modes.name: Wild Mope
modes.confidence: wiki: abilities stronger (speed +10%, cooldown -20%, longer duration); per-animal wave buffs not simulated
modes.description: Everything hits harder, moves faster and recharges quicker.

modes.name: Viral Pandemic
modes.confidence: wiki rules (immunity bar, infection, masks 90 s, aloe 45 s, sneezing); quarantine in holes not simulated
modes.description: Avoid viruses; masks and aloe vera protect you.

modes.name: Beta Mope.io
modes.confidence: wiki: a preview server for unreleased features that alternates between open and closed
modes.description: Not implemented: it is a rotating test server, not a ruleset. The unreleased animals are drawn but not playable.
